---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an addition or change to ALCA
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What coaching workflow, report quality, or operator experience does the current behavior fall short on? Be concrete — name the page, the endpoint, the metric, or the comparison type that motivates the request.

## Proposed change

What you'd like to see, in plain language. If this affects the analysis rubric or a prompt, include a short example of input → desired output.

## Area

- [ ] Analysis rubric / prompt
- [ ] Comparison logic / new comparison type
- [ ] PDF report content or layout
- [ ] Dashboard / trends UI
- [ ] API surface
- [ ] Infrastructure (storage, queue, auth, deployment)

## Expected impact

What does success look like? If you can express it as a measurable change (a metric, a turnaround time, a reduction in manual review), do.

## Alternatives considered

Briefly. "I considered X but rejected it because Y" saves a round trip in review.

## Risk

Anything reviewers should weigh: data exposure, prompt/rubric behavior change, dependency footprint, cost-per-evaluation impact.
